passages.provision_quote: “Race” is inclusive of traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to, hair texture and protective hairstyles.
passages.note: Bill text amends the definition of race under education and FEHA law to include hair texture and protective hairstyles, closing a discrimination loophole.
Senate floor vote on SB 188 passed 37-0 with 1 NVR, naming Caballero among the Ayes.
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 37 Noes Count 0 NVR Count 1

rows.reasoning: The only evidence is her Aye vote on SB 188 (2019-2020), which passed the Senate floor 37-0 with 1 NVR; fewer than 10% voted against, so under V4 the passage is near-unanimous and cannot carry a chair alone. No other source shows her own words or a contested record on civil rights enforcement.
